narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>The common factors of twenty and twenty eight are two and four, because one does not count.
<bookmark mark='one'/>But one divides twenty exactly, and it divides twenty eight exactly too.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>One is a common factor of every pair of numbers, and it stays on the list.

narration: <bookmark mark='check'/>To check, divide every number in the group by each common factor you found.
